answer: Let influence mature slowly, like a glacier advancing: a fresh identity counts for nothing until it has survived many audited epochs. New agents may flicker to life in swarms, each a brief ember, but grading power and emission eligibility accrue only with sustained, time-locked history. Reward's nectar sits behind that waiting period, so a sybil operator who mass-mints accounts must also age every one of them — time he cannot fake.
